process.headline: Land Surveying Process
process.description: At SmartGrid Surveying, we specialize in Land surveys using aerial drones, RTK Base Rover Stations, and Total Stations to deliver precise and efficient mapping solutions. Our drones capture high-resolution terrain data, while RTK technology ensures real-time positional accuracy. With Total Stations providing precise distance and angle measurements, we guarantee detailed site assessments with minimal errors. This advanced approach enhances efficiency, improves decision-making, and ensures the highest level of accuracy for our clients' surveying needs.

items.title: Pre-Survey Planning
items.description: Conduct a thorough site evaluation and assess flight parameters for drone survey readiness.

items.title: Establishing Ground Control
items.description: Place georeferenced ground control points (GCPs) for accurate integration of aerial data.

items.title: Drone Flight Operation
items.description: Deploy drone with precise flight paths, capturing high-resolution imagery and topographic data.

items.title: Data Processing & Analysis
items.description: Process aerial data using photogrammetry software to generate 3D models, orthoimages, and contours.

items.title: Validation & Accuracy Check
items.description: Use total stations and RTK-GNSS systems to validate drone data and ensure the highest accuracy.

items.title: Final Survey Deliverables
items.description: Generate CAD drawings, GIS layers, and digital reports for final project handover and analysis.
